Preserve the asymmetry and long stems and preserve all clear gaps. Rich clean hand-painted 1990s cartoon game art, crisp fine ink, subtle leaf veins, glossy red fruit highlights. Keep original silhouette and no extra padding.

Preserve internal dark red cartoon shading but no notch or flat left flank on the right cherry. Do not add anything. Output transparent background.
